question: What is the main advantage of using solar energy over fossil fuels?

options.text: Greenhouse gas emission is higher when solar energy is used.
Solar energy extraction requires high operational cost when compared to fossil fuels.
Solar energy requires mining and extraction, whereas fossil fuels are free of cost.
Solar energy is abundantly available and renewable in nature.

solution:
The correct answer is:4) Solar energy is abundantly available and renewable in nature.
